items.html: And this is “Open Your eyes and see”: for in AHP there are three times SAG, which in Gematria is “Pekach” [open] with the kollel; and after them comes the discernment of Einayim, and this is “Your eyes.” For these three Ehyeh that are in the Einayim are the discernment of Ehyeh spelled with Yods, which in Gematria is 161, the number of “Your eyes” with the kollel. And this is “and see our desolation,” for here there was a great desolation and the annulment of the kings.
